name: switch
summary: Instant on/off toggle for a setting that applies immediately. Controlled.

accessibility.ariaChecked: true when on; MISSING when off (F4)

do: Use for immediate on/off settings; show :loading while persisting.
dont: Using a switch in a form that needs explicit Save (use MCheckbox).
whenToUse: Immediate on/off settings (enable feature, toggle status).
decisionFlow: Committed only on form Save (opt-in/consent/multi-select)? -> MCheckbox.

switch.useWhen: single binary setting that applies the moment you toggle it
switch.dontUse: if saved with a form (use checkbox) or one-of-many (use radio)

loading.useWhen: the toggle triggers an async persist; block re-toggle until resolved

disabled.useWhen: setting exists but can't change in current state/permission

knownIssues: F1 (medium): defaultChecked is a no-op — MSwitch always passes :checked (default false) which overrides it. Use :checked/v-model.
F2 (medium): on/off changes only the knob color (gray→green) + position; the track color never changes — subtler, color-leaning signal.
F3 (high, a11y): no visible focus ring (outline:none) — WCAG 2.4.7. Add :focus-visible.
F4 (medium, a11y): aria-checked is set when on but missing when off — AT may not announce off. Ensure aria-checked=false.
F5 (low, a11y): ~22px height below the 44px touch target.
changelog: 2026-06-06: full deep-dive — examples fixed to :checked (F1); on/off measured; enhanced standard + Option B pages; a11y F3/F4/F5.

a11y.summary: role=switch; Space/Enter toggle; aria-checked=true when on. ~22×44px (sub-44 target).
issues: aria-checked missing in the OFF state.
On/off signalled mainly by knob colour — add a non-colour cue.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
